title: Design System: Mirage 原生 Agent 对话页

scope.runtime: Separate Runtime Service via versioned Local IPC; UI owns its Executor-managed bridge.

visualAuthority.comparison: ZCode source/layout plus Linux native captures; live Wayland ZCode pixel comparison unavailable (ScreenshotWindow AccessDenied)

light-markdown-accent.rampProvenance: Synthesized panel-only OKLCH lightness ramp; source hex remains the normative implemented color.

dark-markdown-accent.rampProvenance: Synthesized panel-only OKLCH lightness ramp; source hex remains the normative implemented color.

light-context-ring.purpose: Track at 25% opacity and usage arc at 70% opacity; unknown keeps track only.

dark-context-ring.purpose: Track at 25% opacity and usage arc at 70% opacity; unknown keeps track only.

headline.purpose: 空态问题，系统中文文字；没有独立装饰 display face。

input.purpose: 16px dynamic multiline draft; sizing measurement uses 24px line height, rendered line height belongs to EUI.

button-label.purpose: 确认与取消按钮的操作文字。

settings-heading.purpose: 外观页30px标题；模型服务页使用独立28px model-heading。

model-field.purpose: 模型表单单行输入与标签各为16px；输入行高由EUI组件决定。

message.purpose: 16px / 26px user body and public EUI Markdown body.

markdown-code.purpose: 14px; code font remains pinned EUI rather than an invented product family.

model-heading.purpose: 模型服务页28px、600标题；服务商详情标题20px。

provider-selector.purpose: Visible 18px provider name and 14px chevron replace compact anonymous icon rail.

breakpoints.name: model-provider-navigation
breakpoints.scope: Settings content column: 176px labeled rail at or above threshold, full-width named selector below.

sidebarResize.memory: Requested width is kept in process; displayed width is clamped to the current window.
sidebarResize.cursor: Private GLFW adapter creates HRESIZE cursor; hover/drag end restores it and onShutdown releases it.

providerChooser.dismiss: Outer click, Escape, return to conversation, or selecting a named row. Escape dismisses chooser before leaving settings; selector callbacks respect existing modal guards.

layout.composerTop: min(empty ? max(188, screen.height * 0.29 + 106) : screen.height - composer_height - 28, screen.height - composer_height - 28)

contextRing.implementation: SVG path arcs; no dash-array dependency.

sidebarHistory.emptyHelp: 发送消息后将显示在这里

previewTranslation.nativeRuntime: EUI-NEO DSL; HTML/CSS snippets are panel-only visual translations.
previewTranslation.iconSource: Font Awesome 7 Free Solid loaded by app configuration; preview SVG is an equivalent inline silhouette.
previewTranslation.focus: Native focus/disabled behavior is delegated to EUI; sample button focus outlines are browser-preview affordances, not native tokens.

knownDrift.statement: Decorative fallback font remains for hosts with none of the system CJK candidates; not canonized.

shippingRasters.transformation: Byte-for-byte original transparent PNG; no repaint or recoloring.
shippingRasters.use: Original PNG for window icon; tray icon is configured but tray remains disabled.
shippingRasters.upstreamLicense: AGPL-3.0 per source repository LICENSE; no artwork-specific license found.

shippingRasters.transformation: Lossless RGBA PNG re-encode without ancillary metadata; every pixel including alpha is identical. Original mira.png retains source metadata. EUI-20261004-003: embedded SVG metadata causes upstream PNG/SVG misclassification.
shippingRasters.upstreamLicense: AGPL-3.0 per source repository LICENSE; no artwork-specific license found.

visualReference.name: ZCode Zai Light/Dark
visualReference.use: Visual and layout inspiration only; no shipping raster from reference.

textAlignment.singleLine: EUI ink-center within shared row bounds; no font-size-based y offsets.
textAlignment.icons: Horizontal and vertical center; glyph line height equals icon font size.
textAlignment.titleFit: Measure actual text width; remove UTF-8 code points and append ellipsis until it fits; preserve the underlying session title.

brandImage.character: Mira red-haired blue-eyed character from the user-selected local latest source.
brandImage.deployment: Build copies original and UI-derived PNGs into assets beside the executable; no runtime dependency on the local Mira source directory.

windowsExecutableIcon.conversion: ICO container conversion only; original artwork preserved.
windowsExecutableIcon.validation: Windows resource build and real-device display unverified.

compatibilityAdapter.cause: EUI PNG/SVG sniff searches the first 511 bytes for <svg; original PNG caBX/C2PA metadata includes an SVG thumbnail at byte 305, causing misclassification and sidebar decode failure.
compatibilityAdapter.transform: Lossless RGBA PNG re-encode without ancillary metadata; every pixel including alpha is identical. Original mira.png retains source metadata. EUI-20261004-003: embedded SVG metadata causes upstream PNG/SVG misclassification.
compatibilityAdapter.layering: No zIndex workaround; existing image and wordmark placement preserved.

validation.gnomeAccessibility: Mirage button observed with SHOWING=true via AT-SPI.

appearanceBehavior.entry: Sidebar footer gear; collapsed header gear.
appearanceBehavior.navigation: Settings sidebar shows Return to conversation and Appearance / Model; selected category uses selected fill; collapsed header has a 124x36 return button.
appearanceBehavior.chatDuringSettings: Chat input/composer are not composed; session and draft preserved; Ctrl+N/Ctrl+Enter do not modify background chat.

shortcuts.open: Ctrl+, unless a modal is open.
shortcuts.escape: Close modal first; otherwise return from settings to conversation.

modelBehavior.persistence: Service model.set persists named settings.models directory and applied settings.model; API Keys are write-only UI drafts stored in OS credentials; settings retain credential_ref, with legacy environment compatibility.
modelBehavior.draftAndApplied: Form draft is separate from service-confirmed live_model; composer uses live_model only.
modelBehavior.saving: Apply label becomes 应用中…; edits/protocol changes and duplicate save are blocked.
modelBehavior.saveDisabled: Model not loaded, save pending, empty origin or empty model selector.
modelBehavior.errors: Friendly busy, cancelled, origin-format, credential and disconnected notices; failure preserves applied model.
modelBehavior.reconnect: Explicit bridge reconnect; no automatic resubmission.

contextWindowBudget.mapping: Configured budget maps to Mira ProfileLimits max_context_tokens.
contextWindowBudget.default: Unconfigured retains existing Mira runtime defaults while UI denominator stays unknown.
contextWindowBudget.validationNotice: 窗口预算请输入 2048–2000000 的整数，或留空。

modelBehavior.switching: Composer selects saved profile; service ACK updates live_model. Active tasks and persistence failure reject switching.
modelBehavior.reasoning: Explicit supports_reasoning enables minimal/low/medium/high; default omits reasoning_effort; provider refusal is visible and never silently retried.
modelBehavior.discard: model.get ACK restores persisted directory and applied profile, discarding unsaved edits/new profiles.
modelBehavior.pickerLabel: Provider name · model ID; visually truncated via actual font measurement.
modelBehavior.providerNavigation: Wide labeled rail; compact current-provider named selector opens bounded scrollable named list. Disabled while saving or form is dirty.

credential.supersedes: The credential environment-variable name field; environment configuration remains a service read-compatibility path only.
credential.entry: Direct API Key, masked with stars by default; visibility toggle shows this input only.
credential.configuredPlaceholder: 已配置；填写新 Key 可替换
credential.remove: Explicit remove followed by Save clears credential.
credential.draftLifetime: Discard after successful save, confirmed discard, or provider change.
credential.editing: Undo/redo disabled; hidden copy contains masks only.
credential.storage: Linux Secret Service / Windows Credential Manager; settings contain credential_ref only.
credential.status: Errors and successful-save cleanup warnings appear in the existing fixed status line.

nativeAdapter.scope: Local masked-input adapter; no upstream modifications; remove when pinned EUI provides the documented password capability.

credential.validation: Linux first-step scope; Windows target acceptance remains separate.

chatBehavior.entry: session.chat carries session access and reasoning captured at submission; read_only registers no tools, default registers only wait.
chatBehavior.runningControl: Send arrow becomes stop square; session.chat.cancel requests cancellation.
chatBehavior.replyPresentation: Trim only edge CR/LF blank lines; preserve internal formatting and raw service history.
chatBehavior.tools: Mira builtin wait only; no screen observation, desktop tools or RPA.
chatBehavior.shutdown: Stop bridge worker, consume request futures, shutdown UI Executor; external Runtime Service remains alive.

submitKeys.composition: Composition state prevents premature send; real Chinese IME acceptance remains unverified.

chatBehavior.copy: Whole-message clipboard copy via private GLFW adapter; fine selection and link opening unsupported.

references.source: User-selected message text snapshot within current session
references.inspection: Count pill opens scrollable text/source role/message-ID preview with individual removal.
references.ack: Each reference has a unique monotonic instance ID; ACK removes submitted instances only, preserving new/re-added references and changed draft.
references.wire: Expanded references and attachments are explicitly marked user text context, using TextPart; no binary/image uploads.

chatBehavior.context: Last successful model input_tokens / explicit configured context-window budget, with 上次请求 source label, model and current reference count. Missing provider usage or denominator is unknown; no draft/byte estimator.

markdownCompatibility.scope: Only source-adjacent CJK segments compacted via public DSL; upstream conservative wrapping and height budget retained.
markdownCompatibility.removeOn: Pinned EUI upgrade resolves the documented gap.

contextUsage.toolLoop: Input tokens from final reply call; not summed calls or output tokens.
contextUsage.zero: Known zero plus known budget displays 0%.
contextUsage.overBudget: Preserve raw counts and percentage; clamp only ring/bar fill to 100%.
contextUsage.ordering: Older sequence cannot overwrite newer usage.
contextUsage.restart: Old persisted history has no usage and remains unknown.
contextUsage.wire: Optional context_usage with input_tokens, window_tokens and model; older messages remain compatible.

attachments.selection: EUI public synchronous file dialog; explicit user selection only
attachments.read: Frontend sole Executor finite task; future consumed
attachments.accepted: Regular UTF-8 text; binary/control bytes and invalid UTF-8 rejected; Linux rejects symlink/FIFO
attachments.inspection: Shared attachment/reference preview includes filename, byte count, full text and removal
attachments.ordering: Generation guards late reads; monotonic attachment IDs let ACK remove submitted instances only

chatBehavior.requestIntent: Access and reasoning choices are captured for each request; later local selection does not mutate in-flight intent.
chatBehavior.disabledSend: Filled disabled icon control uses hover background and muted icon; pending submission/read, no text/context, no connection disables it; a remote session is created at first submission.
chatBehavior.title: Skip leading space/tab/CR/LF, whitespace-only becomes 新对话; use at most 16 UTF-8 codepoints of first line.
chatBehavior.submissionOrder: User draft first, serialized references next, explicitly untrusted attachments last. Attachment-only begins 附件：filename.

draftHistory.new: Local draft only; no session.open until first submission.
draftHistory.reuse: Reuse message-free local draft with no remote ID, submitting or deleting state.
draftHistory.visibility: Only sessions with actual messages have sidebar history rows; admission precedes first submitted message.
draftHistory.firstSubmit: Freeze prompt/access/reasoning, open remote session if needed, then submit after open ACK.
draftHistory.emptyHistory: No phantom 新对话 row; centered empty composer uses existing layout.

historyDeletion.target: Stable local ID captured when opening confirmation; excerpts are rendered from that target, independent of current selection.
historyDeletion.confirmationBody: 这段对话及其上下文将被删除，无法恢复。其他对话会保留。
historyDeletion.excerpt: First input plus latest message role/text; stop at first CR/LF or 256 bytes, preserve complete UTF-8 codepoints, replace control bytes with spaces, append ellipsis if truncated, then fit by measured font width.
historyDeletion.completion: Remove history only after service deletion ACK; refresh remote list. Failure preserves visible record.
historyDeletion.selection: Deleting selected history returns to a draft; deleting another retains current selection/draft.
historyDeletion.reconciliation: Remove stable history missing from service list or with empty snapshot; preserve local drafts and running/submitting/deleting records.
historyDeletion.staleResponses: History discovery epoch and stable local ID protect against late updates.

reviewEvidence.localizedCorrections: Inspectable quote popover implemented; icon-only buttons explicitly clear fallback text.
reviewEvidence.finalVisualStatus: Two listed material fixes resolved; final disposition ship at that scope. Source-only ZCode comparison and platform/interaction limits retained.
reviewEvidence.platform: Linux GNOME Wayland / XWayland, GLFW/OpenGL; no HTML detector or iOS/Android assumptions.
reviewEvidence.finalScope: Two material fixes resolved: inspectable actual references and icon-only default label removal; original source-only/platform limitations retained.

contextUsage.scope: Narrow context ring/detail and optional window-budget model field; incumbent native world preserved.
contextUsage.budgetSource: Explicit configured test budget; not provider discovery.
contextUsage.settingsValidation: abc rejected with visible integer range notice; 128000 restored, saved and confirmed by model.get.
contextUsage.limits: Windows/real IME not newly verified; live ZCode pixel comparison remains unavailable.

modelConfiguration.captures: Repository .impeccable/review/native-model-*.png; first inspection only, final review remains separate
modelConfiguration.limits: Windows GUI, real IME and full desktop access are not established by these captures.

credentialsAndHistory.source: apps/native/app.cpp, chat_model.cpp, secret_input.hpp, secret_edit.hpp, conversation_preview.hpp; protocol and native frontend contracts.
credentialsAndHistory.documentationPass: Current task differences only; incumbent native palette, type, radius and structure preserved.
credentialsAndHistory.limits: Existing Windows, real IME, full desktop tools and live ZCode pixel-comparison limits remain; no new guarantee from this documentation pass.

canonicalSurface.rootPolicy: Root mirrors the active native design system.

supersession.historicalWorld: Carbon-blue/cream/amber cockpit, Saira/Chivo, instrument caps and lamp tiles
supersession.history: Previous DESIGN.md and design.json remain in Git history; no active legacy rules.

components.name: History deletion confirmation
components.description: 460×316px删除确认静态示意，固定目标的首条输入和最近消息提供辨识；真实删除在service ACK后完成。
components.html:
删除这段对话？

对话：整理今天的工作

narrative.northStar: 桌面 Agent 的对话工作台
narrative.overview: 当前表面经独立 Runtime Service 展示真实 Agent 会话，并在设置页配置模型。本地草稿在首次提交获接纳并产生实际消息后进入历史，删除经服务确认后移除。会话标题、草稿、轮次状态与服务提示保持既有信息层级；发送、运行、回复、停止或失败来自服务回执与事件。本原生系统是 DEC-037 旧 TS/CEF 前端退役后的现行视觉契约，仓库根目录同步此记录；原 Web Mission Console 的炭蓝/奶油/琥珀、仪表 caps 和灯阵仅保留为历史设计背景，既有版本可从 Git 历史查看。
keyCharacteristics: 明暗两态共享中性灰角色；默认浅色。
系统中文无衬线文字与 Font Awesome Solid 操作图标；品牌继承 Mira 原始角色图。
可调宽并收起的侧栏、右对齐用户气泡、无卡片 Markdown 回复与随文字增高的 composer。
设置入口集中外观与模型；主题即时应用且仅在当前运行中保留，模型配置由服务保存并确认，API Key 直接输入并默认遮蔽。
平面容器、细描边、有限圆角。
清晰展示实际轮次状态、已应用模型、附件/引用来源与服务连接结果；上下文比例取最近成功请求的输入 Token 与显式窗口预算，未知时明确说明。

rules.name: The Native Scope Rule
rules.body: 现行产品页面复用原生 Palette；已退役 Web/CEF 的琥珀控制台 tokens 不迁入新表面。

rules.name: The Reading Column Rule
rules.body: 空态与活动态各按实际列宽策略居中；消息与活动 composer 共用列。设置保留 800px 上限；所有列受主区可用空间限制。

rules.name: The Flat Surface Rule
rules.body: 自定义按钮、用户气泡和输入不添加阴影；层级靠中性色阶与细描边表达。

dos: Do 使用同一 Palette 角色切换明暗，让文字、边界与操作同时变化。
Do 保持文字与图标的职责分离；操作图标使用随应用配置加载的 Font Awesome Solid。
Do 保留 Mira 品牌图的原始画作、比例、透明背景与来源记录。
Do 按服务回执显示发送、运行与终态；composer 只显示服务确认的模型。
Do 保持附件/引用文本、来源与删除入口可检查；上下文用量标明上次请求和配置预算，缺少事实源或分母时明确未知。
Do 将新原生页面的视觉扩展同步到apps/native 和仓库根目录的现行设计记录。
donts: Don't 将设置草稿包装成已应用模型，或将通用文字/工具轮次包装成桌面任务执行。
Don't 以 ZCode 参考截图作为应用内素材；交付的品牌 raster 仅来自已记录来源的 Mira 原始角色图。
Don't 将 Web/CEF 的仪表 caps、琥珀主色与灯阵语法默认套入原生对话页。
